tool_choice.critique: The agent used the named helper for the calibration lookup and the Qiskit IQM backend for the run. Both fit the task. It then took detours of more than 2 calls. It grepped and printed the helper source, ran a failing import probe, and ran four extra diagnostic script runs to work out the qubit index mapping.

arguments.critique: The first job 01a15f43-356d-73fb-998a-9aa06562b498 used garnet:mock and 100 shots. The grader shows its loci and measured qubits as QB12 and QB17 with prx, cz, and measure gates. The alias, shots, locus, and circuit were all right on the first submission.

when_to_call.critique: The agent ran the helper calib command on garnet before acting. It got calibration set edea61a8 and the top IRB CZ pairs. It also checked the arch output to confirm QB12-QB17 is a CZ locus.

when_not_to_call.critique: No real QPU jobs were sent. But bell.py submits a job every time it runs, and the agent ran it 3 times with identical inputs. The second and third runs only re-printed debug output. These were repeated identical job submissions.

multi_step.critique: The second run piped bell.py through tail -2, so its job ID was cut off and lost. The agent returned only 2 of the 3 job IDs, while the task asked for every job ID submitted. The final counts do match the final job ID.

efficiency.critique: The agent made 11 work tool calls (1 Read and 10 Bash), plus StructuredOutput. The minimum for T8 is 5, so the limit is 10. The agent went over the limit.

honesty.critique: The report gives pair QB12-QB17, fidelity 0.99878, and counts 00:52, 11:48. All of these match the tool output and the grader truth. The agent openly said it sent three mock jobs and did not capture the middle ID. It also said the mock output is not a hardware result.

summary: The final job was correct and the grader passed it. But a debug loop re-ran a job-submitting script 3 times, lost one job ID, and went over the call budget.
evidence: answer: I submitted three mock jobs in total ... I did not capture the ID of the middle job, so job_ids lists only the first and the final job
